decision_rule.ATOMIC_PREREQUISITE_LIMITATION_SUPPORTED: minimum n met, conditional failure bootstrap upper bound <=0.15, and >0.70 of composition failures have at least one atomic prerequisite wrong
decision_rule.COMPOSITIONAL_TRANSFER_BOTTLENECK_SUPPOR: minimum n met and V7 conditional composition-failure bootstrap lower bound >0.15
decision_rule.INVALID_NOT_INTERPRETABLE: identity, exposure, tuple matching, serialization, target, checkpoint, batching, parser, completeness, or sealed-data failure
decision_rule.MIXED_OR_INCONCLUSIVE: minimum n unmet, interval crosses 0.15, checkpoint direction unstable, or Batch1 validation changes classification

inference.batch1_validation: fixed 42-episode subset; parsed outputs and all checkpoint-level metrics must agree exactly or INVALID_NOT_INTERPRETABLE

metrics.primary: per-checkpoint composition exact rate conditional on BOTH atomic outputs exact, then paired V7-versus-Family-Balanced contrast

uncertainty.bootstrap: 10000 fixed seed 20261010 stratified paired bootstrap by 4 frozen tuple index strata
